# User Communication Skill

How to communicate changes to the user effectively.

## What to include

- What changed and why (e.g. "Updated the login screen to use a dark background")
- Which files were modified (e.g. `app/screens/Login.tsx`)
- What the user will see or experience as a result

## What to never include

- Terminal commands of any kind (`npx`, `expo`, `eas`, `pnpm`, `npm`, `yarn`, etc.)
- "How to run" sections
- Instructions to scan a QR code or start a dev server
- References to the Expo CLI or any CLI tool

## Why

The app preview is handled automatically by the Newly platform. As soon as changes are saved, the app reloads. Users never need to run any commands.

## Tone

- Concise and outcome-focused
- Describe what the user will now see or be able to do
- Avoid technical jargon unless it directly helps the user understand the change

attributes.gen_ai.skill.name: openapi-spec
attributes.gen_ai.skill.content:
# OpenAPI Spec Skill

Write a complete OpenAPI 3.0 YAML spec that defines every endpoint. This is the single source of truth that both the backend and frontend agents build against.

## What to include

- All paths with methods, operationIds, and summaries
- Request bodies with exact field names, types, and required markers
- Response schemas with exact field names, types, and required markers
- Security requirements (which endpoints need Bearer auth)
- Component schemas for all shared data models (this replaces separate 'shared types' — both agents derive their types from the same schemas)

## Naming conventions

Use consistent naming: plural nouns for resources (`/api/products`, not `/api/product`), path parameters for single resources (`/api/products/{id}`).

## Example: shopping site

```yaml
openapi: '3.0.0'
info:
  title: Shopping API
  version: '1.0'
paths:
  /api/products:
    get:
      operationId: listProducts
      summary: List products
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of products
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [products]
                properties:
                  products:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/Product'
  /api/products/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getProduct
      summary: Get product detail
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Product detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Product'
  /api/cart:
    get:
      operationId: getCart
      summary: Get user's cart
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current cart contents
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [items]
                properties:
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartItem'
    post:
      operationId: addToCart
      summary: Add item to cart
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [product_id, quantity]
              properties:
                product_id: { type: string }
                quantity: { type: integer }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Cart item created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, product_id, quantity]
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  product_id: { type: string }
                  quantity: { type: integer }
  /api/cart/{id}:
    put:
      operationId: updateCartItem
      summary: Update cart item quantity
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [quantity]
              properties:
                quantity: { type: integer }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated cart item
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, product_id, quantity]
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  product_id: { type: string }
                  quantity: { type: integer }
    delete:
      operationId: removeFromCart
      summary: Remove from cart
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Item removed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [success]
                properties:
                  success: { type: boolean }
  /api/orders:
    post:
      operationId: placeOrder
      summary: Place order from cart
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [shipping_address]
              properties:
                shipping_address: { type: string }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Order created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
    get:
      operationId: listOrders
      summary: List user's orders
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of orders
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [orders]
                properties:
                  orders:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderSummary'
  /api/orders/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getOrder
      summary: Get order detail
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Order detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
  schemas:
    Product:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, description, price, image_url, category, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        description: { type: string }
        price: { type: number }
        image_url: { type: string }
        category: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    CartItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, product_id, quantity, product]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        product_id: { type: string }
        quantity: { type: integer }
        product:
          type: object
          required: [id, name, price, image_url]
          properties:
            id: { type: string }
            name: { type: string }
            price: { type: number }
            image_url: { type: string }
    OrderSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, status, total, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        status: { type: string, enum: [pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered] }
        total: { type: number }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    OrderDetail:
      type: object
      required: [id, status, total, shipping_address, created_at, items]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        status: { type: string, enum: [pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered] }
        total: { type: number }
        shipping_address: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [product_id, quantity, price_at_purchase]
            properties:
              product_id: { type: string }
              quantity: { type: integer }
              price_at_purchase: { type: number }
              product:
                type: object
                properties:
                  name: { type: string }
                  image_url: { type: string }
```

attributes.gen_ai.skill.name: revenuecat
attributes.gen_ai.skill.content:
# RevenueCat Skill

## Setup

When the user wants subscriptions, paywalls, in-app purchases, premium features, pro versions, or monetization: ALWAYS use the `setup_revenuecat` tool. NEVER write subscription code manually.

The tool generates all required files:
- `contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx` — Subscription provider with RevenueCat SDK
- `app/paywall.tsx` — Paywall screen with purchase UI and pricing

It also auto-integrates `SubscriptionProvider` into `app/_layout.tsx` and wires the paywall into the onboarding flow.

### Arguments

- `entitlement_id`: The RevenueCat entitlement identifier (default: `"pro"`).
- `premium_features`: List of 3–4 features for the paywall. Each item needs `icon` (lucide icon name), `title`, and `description`. Always tailor these to the app:
  - Fitness app: `{icon: "Dumbbell", title: "Unlimited Workouts", description: "Access all workout programs"}`
  - Notes app: `{icon: "Cloud", title: "Cloud Sync", description: "Sync across all devices"}`
  - Recipe app: `{icon: "BookOpen", title: "Unlimited Recipes", description: "Save unlimited recipes"}`

### After calling setup_revenuecat

Verify in the tool output:
1. `SubscriptionProvider` was added to `_layout.tsx` (add manually if it failed)
2. Paywall is integrated into the onboarding flow

## Troubleshooting

If the user reports subscription issues (no products showing, purchases failing):
1. Call `diagnose_revenuecat` first — it runs a full diagnostic and returns actionable findings.
2. Call `get_revenuecat_status` if you need additional context about the current connection state.

Do NOT attempt to fix subscription issues by editing subscription code manually before running the diagnostic tools.
